tool.name: iowa_business_search
tool.title: Iowa Business Entity Registry Search
tool.description:
Search the official Iowa Secretary of State business registry by legal, fictitious, or former name. Returns business number, matched name, legal name, status, and name type.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/ia-business-entity-search'.
- Side Effects: Strictly read-only; queries the public Iowa business registry.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN.
- Latency & Limits: Typical runs take 10-30 seconds; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for Iowa company verification, DBA resolution, former-name research, and business lead enrichment.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for other states, contractor licensing, or officer-name searches.
- Named alternatives: Use 'us_business_entity_search' for a multi-state search, 'wisconsin_business_search' for Wisconsin, or 'florida_officer_search' for Florida officer and registered-agent names.

search_query.description: Full or partial business, fictitious, or former name.

business_number.description: Iowa Secretary of State business number.

type.description: Legal, fictitious, or former name classification.

legal_name.description: Registered legal name of the owning entity.
